title: Dance
learning_outcomes: Explain rhythm and space in the context of dance.
Compare and distinguish dance traditions in the context of dance.
Apply accessible movement in the context of dance.
Evaluate and justify decisions about expression and consent in the context of dance.

lessons.title: Rhythm and space
lessons.outcome: Explain rhythm and space in the context of dance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving rhythm and space; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to choreography study.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain rhythm and space from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of rhythm and space; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Dance traditions
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish dance traditions in the context of dance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving dance traditions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to choreography study.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain dance traditions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of dance traditions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Accessible movement
lessons.outcome: Apply accessible movement in the context of dance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving accessible movement; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to choreography study.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain accessible movement from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of accessible movement; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Expression and consent
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about expression and consent in the context of dance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving expression and consent; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to choreography study.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain expression and consent from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of expression and consent; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of rhythm and space; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of dance traditions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of accessible movement; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of expression and consent; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practising artist or arts educator; cultural expertise where relevant.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
